Hello,
I came in yesterday to get my cat vaccinated and for a general check-up because he had some small scabs on his neck. Dr. Fage examined him thoroughly because he had been bitten by insects from the gardens, and she prescribed anti-inflammatories. The problem is that he's very cooperative at your clinic, but it's not the same at home! 😀
I highly recommend this veterinary clinic; the whole team is incredibly competent! 👍

Today we had an appointment for an urgent electrocardiogram for my 14-year-old dog. The appointment was at 5:30, but my calendar showed it as 4:30. I obviously took her an hour early, but they didn't seem to care that she was nervous and we couldn't come back an hour later. They didn't see us earlier or help us reschedule. But when we asked to cancel, they did so quickly.
They were really welcoming and took the time to answer questions. They really took the time to explain everything, even though it was our very first pet.
A very welcoming and friendly clinic. Thank you!
My two cats had their check-up. The welcome, advice, and the way the vet treated my fur babies were all perfect. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

This is Jasmine's veterinary clinic; my 11-year-old Chihuahua attends them, and I'm very happy with the care she receives. Last year, the staff saved her life; she was given IV fluids for three days, which was very stress-free for her. She has regular visits from veterinary cardiologists who perform electrocardiograms to monitor her heart murmur, and during my last visit, the vet gave her a very effective treatment for her eyes.

Furthermore, the clinic handles sending the bill for Jasmine's care directly to her health insurance, and I'm reimbursed very quickly.

I highly recommend this clinic; they treat your four-legged companions like their own. 🙏🏻🐶💖

Dr. Fage must hate dogs to be so unpleasant. I came to the vet seeking reassurance after adopting my dog ​​(an abandoned adult). I returned a few days later for a check-up and advice. The vet was very unpleasant to me and rough with my dog, who was already stressed from the appointment. She kept curtly telling me to hold him, moving him roughly even when he wasn't doing anything. My dog ​​weighs 5 kg. She gave me no advice other than to belittle the fact that I adopted this abandoned dog at my age. I paid a lot to be treated with contempt and to stress my dog ​​out.
Unfortunately, it's become a money-making machine. It's incomprehensible; their only interest is charging. It's a shame, because back then there were some good veterinarians.

Avoid this place with your puppies. I'm still reeling from what I witnessed this morning. It was our 2-month-old puppy's first visit, just a check-up to help him feel more comfortable at the vet. While he was perfectly calm, the vet grabbed him by the scruff of the neck and squeezed him tightly as she lifted him up. She told me this was necessary to tame him because otherwise corgis do whatever they want. The poor puppy howled in pain and even wet himself out of fear. Unwilling to let go, she shook him until he bit in self-defense. It was a horrific scene that shocked my children as much as I did. There was absolutely no justification for this outdated behavior, especially with a 2-month-old puppy who was completely calm and trusting. He will undoubtedly develop a terrible fear of the vet. I absolutely do not recommend this place!
